items.title: Thermo Fisher (TMO) Lands ImmuPharma Kapiglucagon Diabetes Manufacturing Role
items.summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific (NYSE:TMO) has been selected by ImmuPharma as the key drug product and contract development manufacturer for its Kapiglucagon diabetes treatment program. The partnership covers development and manufacturing support for Kapiglucagon, an experimental therapy aimed at addressing diabetes. items.title: Why Is Thermo Fisher (TMO) Stock Rocketing Higher Today
items.summary: Shares of life sciences company Thermo Fisher (NYSE:TMO) jumped 9.7% in the afternoon session after the company reported strong second-quarter earnings that beat Wall Street's estimates for both profit and revenue. For the quarter, the company reported adjusted earnings per share of $6.03, topping expectations of $5.71.
